login.title: Sign in to Tallyvane admin
login.lead: For administrators only. Use the Google account that has the right to administer.
login.fineprint: We only use Google to confirm who you are. Tallyvane never sees your Google password.
login.failed: We couldn't reach Google just now. Try again in a moment.
login.problemRestart: That sign-in took a wrong turn. Start again, please.
login.problemExpired: That sign-in took too long and timed out. Start again, please.
login.problemCancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
login.problemRefused: Google didn't let us confirm who you are. Try again, or use another Google account.
login.problemEmailUnverified: Google hasn't verified that email address, so we can't use it. Verify it with Google, or use another account.
login.problemUnavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

continue.title: Signing you in
continue.failed: We couldn't finish signing you in.
continue.closeTab: You're signed in. You can close this tab.
continue.ended: That sign-in has ended. Start again, please.
continue.blocked: Set up the authenticator app in Tallyvane first (Settings, Security), then sign in here again.

verify.title: Enter your code
verify.lead: One more step to finish signing in.
verify.failed: We couldn't check your sign-in just now. Try again in a moment.
verify.ended: That sign-in has ended. Start again, please.
verify.blocked: Set up the authenticator app in Tallyvane first (Settings, Security), then sign in here again.

secondFactor.codeHint: Six digits from your authenticator app.
secondFactor.recoveryHint: Ten characters, like ABCDE-FGHJK. Each code works once.
secondFactor.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check your app and try again.
secondFactor.wrongRecovery: That recovery code didn't work. Check it and try again.
secondFactor.paused: Too many tries. Try again in {seconds} s.
secondFactor.pausedAnnouncement: Too many tries. You can try again in {seconds} seconds.
secondFactor.failed: We couldn't check that code just now. Try again in a moment.
secondFactor.useApp: Use the code from your app

recoveryUsed.used: You signed in with a recovery code.
recoveryUsed.noneLeft: You have no recovery codes left.
recoveryUsed.retired: Your authenticator app no longer works. Set it up again in Tallyvane (Settings, Security). Until then only your recovery codes sign you in, and each works once.

reauth.title: Your session expired
reauth.lead: Sign in again to continue. Your unsaved work is still here, and we'll finish saving it right after.
reauth.different: Signing in as a different person will discard these changes.
reauth.failed: We couldn't reach Google just now.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.lead: This can't be undone, so we need you to sign in with Google once more. If you use an authenticator app, we'll ask for a code in the window that opens. The page behind stays as it is.
stepUp.failed: We couldn't reach Google just now.

stepUpContinue.title: Confirming it's you
stepUpContinue.done: Confirmed. You can close this tab.
stepUpContinue.otherAccount: That was a different Google account. Close this tab and try again with the one you are signed in with.
stepUpContinue.lead: If you use an authenticator app, we ask for a code too.
stepUpContinue.ended: That confirmation has ended. Close this tab and try again.
stepUpContinue.recoveryUsed: You used a recovery code, so your authenticator app no longer works. Set it up again in Tallyvane, in Settings, Security.

necessity.when_enrolled: Only those who set it up

history.title: Versions
history.lead: Every change keeps a new version. Putting one in force, or rolling back to an older one, is recorded with who did it and why.
history.refreshFailed: We couldn't refresh the versions. This list may be out of date.
history.inForceNote: In force since {when}, put there by {by}.

activation.previewFailed: We couldn't check what this would change, so it can't be put in force right now.
activation.failed: We couldn't put this version in force. Try again in a moment.
activation.commentInvalid: Write a reason of 1 to 500 characters, without control characters.
activation.wouldLockOut: No administrator could sign in under this version, so it stays out of force.
activation.gone: That version is no longer there.

save.failed: We couldn't save the version. Try again in a moment.

policies.title: Sign-in policies
policies.lead: What a person must do to register or sign in. The server checks the bounds; a version outside them is not kept.

policyEditor.title: New version: {purpose}
policyEditor.lead: Started from version {number}. Nothing changes for anyone until you put it in force.
policyEditor.stepsHint: A person passes a step with any one of the factors it accepts. Steps are taken in order.
policyEditor.maxFailures: Wrong answers before it is over
policyEditor.firstDelay: Pause after the first wrong answer
policyEditor.firstDelayHint: Each next wrong answer doubles the pause.

policyWords.limits: {lifetime} to finish, {failures} wrong answers, first pause {delay}
policyWords.cannotPass: {count} of them could not finish a sign-in under it.

lifetimes.title: Session lifetimes
lifetimes.lead: How long a session may live, and how long a proof of who someone is stays fresh. A tighter version ends sessions at their next request; people sign in again.

lifetimeEditor.title: New version: {client}
lifetimeEditor.lead: Started from version {number}. Nothing changes for anyone until you put it in force.
lifetimeEditor.idleHint: A session unused this long ends.
lifetimeEditor.absoluteHint: However much it is used, a session ends after this.
lifetimeEditor.freshnessHint: How long a sign-in counts as recent for a dangerous act.

lifetimeWords.summary: Unused for {idle}, lives at most {absolute}, proof fresh for {freshness}
lifetimeWords.sessions: {count} sessions of this client are live now.
lifetimeWords.wouldEnd: {count} of them would end at once.

faults.unknown: The server does not know this choice.
faults.stepEmpty: Step {position} accepts no factor. Pick at least one.
faults.nothingIdentifies: No step applies to everyone with no setup, such as Google, so the account would never be learned.
faults.belowTheFloor: This purpose always demanded a second factor, and this version would stop demanding it.
faults.wouldLockPeopleOut: A step demands a second factor from everyone, so a person without one could not sign in to set it up.
faults.outOfBoundsAttemptLifetime: The time a sign-in stays open is outside the range the server allows.
faults.outOfBoundsMaxFailures: The number of wrong answers is outside the range the server allows.
faults.outOfBoundsFirstDelay: The first pause is outside the range the server allows.
faults.outOfBoundsIdle: The unused time is outside the range the server allows.
faults.outOfBoundsAbsolute: The longest life is longer than the server allows.
faults.outOfBoundsFreshness: The freshness of the proof is outside the range the server allows.
faults.belowIdle: The longest life of a session cannot be shorter than the time it may go unused.
faults.commentInvalid: Write a reason of 1 to 500 characters, without control characters.
